# Speaker Card

`events/speaker-card` &middot; content-level &middot; category: events

## Purpose

A speaker: a round photo, name, title, a short bio and an optional profile link.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `speaker` | object { photo, name, title, bio, href } |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Centered speaker card.
- **left**: Left-aligned. Sets `align: left`.
- **large**: A larger 128px photo. Sets `photoSize: 128px`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `align` | alignment | `"center"` |
| `photoSize` | length | `"96px"` |
| `linkLabel` | text | `"View profile"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Text and photo honored, the circular crop is square. | Fine. Alt text names the speaker if images are blocked. | Text swaps via dm-text and dm-muted where honored. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('events/speaker-card', {
  "speaker": {
    "photo": {
      "src": "https://placehold.co/200x200/png?text=Elena",
      "alt": "Portrait of Elena Ruiz holding a skein of naturally dyed yarn"
    },
    "name": "Elena Ruiz",
    "title": "Textile artist and natural dye specialist",
    "bio": "Elena has taught plant dyeing for twelve years and runs a small dye garden outside Lisbon.",
    "href": "https://example.com/team/elena-ruiz"
  }
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "events/speaker-card",
  "data": {
    "speaker": {
      "photo": {
        "src": "https://placehold.co/200x200/png?text=Elena",
        "alt": "Portrait of Elena Ruiz holding a skein of naturally dyed yarn"
      },
      "name": "Elena Ruiz",
      "title": "Textile artist and natural dye specialist",
      "bio": "Elena has taught plant dyeing for twelve years and runs a small dye garden outside Lisbon.",
      "href": "https://example.com/team/elena-ruiz"
    }
  }
}
```
